title: myroxylon pringlei
intro: Myroxylon pringlei, commonly known as the Peruvian Palo Santo, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Myroxylon pringlei include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve mood, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia and pain. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to promote healing, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Myroxylon pringlei include limonene, beta-pinene, and beta-caryophyllene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
